recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central photographic landscape framed by a geometric border, set against a textured watercolor parchment background with a circular symbolic medallion at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured parchment background containing a framed photographic window
Symmetrical typography flanking a central circular emblem
Warm sunset lighting in the photo harmonizing with the ochre background tones
Geometric step-pattern corners on the internal frame echoing Southwestern motifs
coreInvariants: Parchment/watercolor paper texture throughout the outer margins
Thin black line border with stepped interior corners
Centralized vertical axis for all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man with a guitar is positioned in the lower right third of the central photographic frame, looking left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular geometric medallion at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top medallion, moves horizontally across the artist name, down to the title, and finally into the photographic landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the upper parchment area and the sky within the photograph to allow for legibility.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sunset oranges and muted blues (within the photograph)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high-texture background contrasting with medium-saturation photographic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Consistent stroke weight with minimal contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Increased letter spacing (tracking) for a wide, cinematic feel

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed on parchment background above the photo frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scales and tracking to maintain a cohesive Americana look.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic slab serif with sturdy, geometric proportions.
Traditional Americana feel with strong serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured watercolor background in ochre and tan. In the center, place a rectangular photographic window showing a man with a guitar at sunset. Surround the photo with a thin black line frame featuring stepped interior corners. Place a circular geometric medallion at the top center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase slab-serif text in dark charcoal. The artist name should be split by the medallion at the top. The title should be centered below the medallion but above the photo frame, with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visible and organic?
Are the frame corners stepped inward?
Is the typography centered and widely spaced?
Does the color palette remain in the warm earth-tone range?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the top medallion design
Subject matter within the photographic frame
Width of the slab serif strokes
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is not overlapping the photographic frame.
Check that the watercolor texture does not obscure the legibility of the slab serif text.
Verify the stepped corners are symmetrical on all four sides.
Confirm the medallion is perfectly centered between the first and last name.
recipe.reuseFormula: Textured Parchment + Stepped Frame + Slab Serif Typography + Central Medallion = Southwestern Folk Aesthetic
